claim_summary: TS-Agent contributes a case-guided, scaffolded financial time-series modeling workflow that records experiment context and uses performance feedback to refine forecasting and generation models.

claim_evidence.quote:
The TS-Agent consists of two stages: (1) the model pre-selection
stage, and (2) the code refinement stage, depicted in Figure 1(a).

The agent iteratively updates train.py by leveraging both external
resources and the training performance from previous executions of
train.py.

modules.name: Performance-gated round-robin refinement
modules.scope_reason: R3_1 matches: the warm-up selects the model/refinement/configuration by the task evaluation criterion, and subsequent edits are accepted only when loss improves. Replacing forecasting with generation changes the output objective and verifier implemented by the model/measure bank. Feedback changes actions within one modeling run; no reusable cross-episode policy or LLM-parameter update is demonstrated.

notes: No LLM training is established: fine-tuning edits downstream task-model hyperparameters. Within-run reflective search is Planning and Orchestration, not cross-episode Optimization and Evolution. Unchanged model implementations, baselines and evaluation datasets are not separate contributions. Generic train/test separation and knowledge-bank entries mentioning leakage or walk-forward evaluation do not establish chronological/leakage-safe experiments. Sharpe/VaR/ES differences are prediction or synthesis fidelity measures, not evaluated downstream action utility, so decision_support is not added.
